translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「……それをあたしに調査しろっての？」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: in the lab and hospital, so this will be good experience.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: but it certainly also has that side.」

ミックスが乱暴に扉を開け閉めして出て行った。
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Mix violently opened and closed the door and left.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「はっはっはっ、短気な娘だ。

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I wonder who in my family she takes after for that.」

そこには吸い込まれそうな風景が

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: it seemed to pull one in, spreading infinitely.

次の日――

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: and finally returned to the original world.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「うっ……くぅーーーっ！」
